title: Starting Date of a Mobile Wallet Resend's Waiting Period
content:
Operations counting convention for **Mobile Wallet** resends: the date from which the days a resend has waited are counted.

**Convention.** The days a resend has waited are counted from a starting date set by the transfer's bounces (its reversed-credit entries):

1. when every bounce on the transfer was on Paloma's or the provider's side (rejection reason provider unavailable), from the date the transfer was booked;
2. when the transfer bounced at least 2 times and at least one bounce was on the recipient's side (any other rejection reason), from the date of its first bounce, that is the reversed-credit entry of credit attempt 1;
3. otherwise, a single recipient-side bounce, from the date part of the moment the credit failed, its latest bounce.

## Input, judgement, starting date (hypothetical transfers)

| Bounces on the transfer | Judgement | Waiting counted from |
|---|---|---|
| attempt 1 provider unavailable on 2026-02-02; booked 2026-02-01 | every bounce on Paloma's side | 2026-02-01, the booking date |
| attempt 1 provider unavailable on 2026-02-02, attempt 2 wallet suspended on 2026-02-06 | two bounces, one on the recipient's side | 2026-02-02, the first bounce |
| attempt 1 wallet limit exceeded on 2026-02-03, attempt 2 wallet limit exceeded on 2026-02-09 | two bounces, recipient's side | 2026-02-03, the first bounce |
| attempt 1 wallet not registered, failed at 2026-02-05 17:40 | a single recipient-side bounce | 2026-02-05, the date the credit failed |
